title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-30-draft
content:
Weekly Sync: Serving Runtime + Infra + Console - Agenda (Draft)
Date: 2026-03-30 10:00-11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #eng-serving-runtime channel
Owner: Jordan Miller
Attendees (expected): Jordan Miller, Maya Lopez, Ethan Park, Priya Narayanan, Sam Gonzalez, Devon Hsu
Purpose: Align on ops/regressions, rollout plan for q2 kernel updates, console UX blockers for rollout, and surface infra capacity needs for Dedicated clusters.

Flow / Timeboxing:
- 10:00 - 10:05: Quick sync + one-blockers (round-robin) — Jordan
- 10:05 - 10:25: Q2 kernel update rollout status + safety checks — Maya (15m) + QA
- 10:25 - 10:40: Console rollout blocking issues (auth, session traces) — Priya (10m) + demo of error case
- 10:40 - 10:50: Infra capacity / Dedicated cluster forecast + autoscale tests — Ethan (10m)
- 10:50 - 11:00: Open action items, risks, and next steps — Jordan

Pre-reads / Context (please skim before meeting):
- Notes from last week: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SERV/Serving+Runtime+Weekly+Notes
- Kernel rollout runbook (internal): SERV-1423
- Console PR with session-trace fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/412
- Serving runtime PR for kv-cache improvement: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789

Agenda details / talking points:
1) Kernel rollout status (Maya)
   - Current status: staged to canary (10% traffic) in us-west-2, no regressions in perf tests.
   - Open issues: one tail-latency spike on long-context tests (LL-ctx-512+), suspected kernel scheduling mismatch.
   - Decisions needed: whether to pause rollout until patch for scheduler is in; risk tolerance for another 24-hour canary.
   - Notes to bring: heap/proc profiles (Ethan to attach), recent regression logs (Maya).

2) Console: session traces auth bug + UX blocker (Priya)
   - Bug: session traces failing for some orgs with SSO-linked accounts (500 on fetch). Repro steps in PR.
   - Impact: blocks internal partner demo and customers using session-trace feature.
   - Short-term mitigations: fallback to logs-only view, add feature flag. Long-term: fix auth flow in console backend.
   - PR status: review pending, Reviewer: Sam Gonzalez.

3) Infra capacity & Dedicated forecast (Ethan)
   - Forecast: expected Dedicated commit increases from AcmeCorp and NimbusAI next month (~+40% GPU hours).
   - Action: run autoscale stress test by 2026-04-06; confirm burst capacity config.
   - Constraint: region us-east-1 GPU quotas low; need quota request timeline if commit goes live.

4) Open items from last week (quick updates)
   - ACTION A: Jordan to follow up with SRE on egress throttling rules (in-progress).
   - ACTION B: Maya to add KV-cache regression tests to CI (done, merged to canary branch).
   - ACTION C: Priya to gather repro traces for console auth bug (in-progress).

Action items (tracked):
- ACTION-2026-03-30-1: Maya Lopez — investigate tail-latency spike, attach heap/proc profiles to SERV-1423 by 2026-03-31. (owner: Maya Lopez; status: in_progress; linked: SERV-1423, PR#789)
- ACTION-2026-03-30-2: Ethan Park — run autoscale stress test in staging, report results and update burst config by 2026-04-06. (owner: Ethan Park; status: todo; linked: infra-autoscale-test-2026)
- ACTION-2026-03-30-3: Priya Narayanan — open console backend fix PR for session auth bug, include regression test; target 2026-04-02. (owner: Priya Narayanan; status: in_progress; linked: PR#412)
- ACTION-2026-03-30-4: Jordan Miller — follow up with SRE and confirm egress throttling policy action or rollback plan by 2026-03-31. (owner: Jordan Miller; status: in_progress)
- ACTION-2026-03-30-5: Sam Gonzalez — complete review of console PR #412 and approve or request changes by 2026-03-31. (owner: Sam Gonzalez; status: todo)

Risks / blockers:
- If kernel scheduler patch not ready, we may need to roll back canary which would delay Q2 rollout and impact perf improvements tied to cost reductions.
- US-east GPU quota could prevent Dedicated commitments from being met on time; slack SRE for quota increase now.

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this meeting):
- Evaluate KV-cache eviction heuristics for multi-tenant workloads (dev backlog).
- Longer-term: schedule reliability runbook rehearsal for on-call rotation (SRE + runtime).

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Remind Maya to include per-sequence length histograms in profiles.
- Add postmortem template link to action items once we decide to rollback.
- Ask sales: exact DDU commitment dates for NimbusAI (needed for capacity planning).

Next sync: 2026-04-06 10:00 PT

-- end of draft --

(Quick editing checklist before finalizing agenda: ensure PR links resolve, update statuses, attach logs/profiles to SERV-1423, ping Sam for reviewer bandwidth)
